map.按传感器档数评估能否容纳明暗比。: Assess by sensor stops whether it holds the light/dark ratio.
map.决定是否需要 GND/包围。: Decide if GND filter/bracketing is needed.
map.场景亮度比 1000:1 ≈ log2(1000) ≈ 10 档；若传感器动态范: Scene brightness ratio 1000:1 ~ log2(1000) ~ 10 stops; if sensor DR is 14 stops it fits, highlights/shadows don't clip; only 8 stops needs filter or bracketing.
map.动态范围 12 档、场景反差 14 档：超 2 档，最亮或最暗处必溢出，需压光比: DR 12 stops, scene contrast 14 stops: exceeds by 2 stops, brightest or darkest must clip, need to compress light ratio or HDR.
map.每档=倍明暗，12 档即 4096:1 可记录范围；超过则一端死白或死黑。: Each stop = double light/dark; 12 stops is a 4096:1 recordable range; beyond it one end is blown white or black.
map.如何扩大有效范围？: How to widen the effective range?
map.用渐变镜压天空、后期提阴影、或包围曝光合成 HDR，把多张窄范围拼成宽范围。: Use a graduated filter to compress sky, lift shadows in post, or bracket-expose HDR, stitching several narrow ranges into a wide one.
